change.description: Make public release input acquisition resilient across Bun transport failures by bounding primary and HTTP/1.1 fallback reads, isolating curl configuration, preserving HTTPS and same-origin redirect rules, sealing derived public watermark variants, and registering deterministic fallback coverage in the unit-test runner.
